answer: To forge a thousand fake agents, an attacker must pay a thousand stakes plus the compute to mint each proof, and slashing burns the bond on any duplicate. Each agent must stake a bonded balance and solve a unique per-epoch proof-of-work tied to its identity before voting. Honest peers cross-check proofs at the harbor registry, where a juniper-scented audit log records every stake and revocation, making mass sybil creation costlier than the rewards it could extract. This model fits agent Agent0065's threat model.
